en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Salih Bin Al Sindy, from Ja’far Bin Basheer, from Al Husayn Bin Abu Al A’la, from Abu Makhlad Al Sarraj, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> judged regarding a man who called another, ‘Son of the insane’. So the other one said to him, ‘You are a son of the insane’. So he<sup>asws</sup> ordered that the first one (who was slandered) to whip his companion with twenty lashes, and said to him, ‘Know that he is also deserving the like of it, twenty’. So when he had whipped him, he<sup>asws</sup> gave the whip to the whipped one, so he whipped him, being a lesson to be learnt by both of them’.
